title: Netzwerk aufgedeckt - Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse gegen den illegalen Handel mit Betäubungsmitteln vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors searched 16 properties in Berlin, Saxony and Brandenburg over a drug-dealing network supplying cocaine and cannabis. Four people were arrested and about 1.3 kg of cocaine, 20 kg of cannabis and other drugs were seized.
